name: todox
description: The log your next session resumes from: decisions, dead ends, handoffs and open tasks, shared across machines, agents and people over the todox MCP server. Briefs a session with the log at start, and asks once for its handoff before it finishes.

interface.shortDescription: The log your next session resumes from
interface.longDescription: Decisions, dead ends, handoffs and open tasks, kept per repository over the todox MCP server. The session starts with a briefing from the log and is asked for its handoff before it finishes.
